notes: Gaps for the owner: (1) R40 fails open when an existing account's statement file is unreadable or does not load (probe reproduced); options are to refuse the import as case damage, or to compare the file against the import entry's statement_sha256 and refuse on mismatch. Needs a design call, not done here. (2) Design Failure-modes row R39 says the log notes a repeat import; P9 and T32 require the log head unchanged; the design row should be corrected. (3) The 'most' threshold is >50% of the new statement's lines in the overlap, so a one-line overlap that matches is refused; acceptable under R40's wording but worth stating in the design.
